message.content:
{
  "settings": [
    {"name": "FORMAT", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "Specifies the copy function to use. The default is selected from the file extension (e.g., `.parquet` results in a Parquet file being written/read)."},
    {"name": "USE_TMP_FILE", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "Whether or not to write to a temporary file first if the original file exists (`target.csv.tmp`)."},
    {"name": "OVERWRITE_OR_IGNORE", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "Whether or not to allow overwriting files if they already exist."},
    {"name": "OVERWRITE", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "When `true`, all existing files inside targeted directories will be removed (not supported on remote filesystems)."},
    {"name": "APPEND", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "When `true`, in the event a filename pattern is generated that already exists, the path will be regenerated to ensure no existing files are overwritten."},
    {"name": "FILENAME_PATTERN", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "Set a pattern to use for the filename, can optionally contain `{uuid}` / `{uuidv4}` or `{uuidv7}` to be filled in with a generated UUID (v4 or v7, respectively), and `{i}`, which is replaced by an incrementing index."},
    {"name": "FILE_EXTENSION", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "Set the file extension that should be assigned to the generated file(s)."},
    {"name": "PER_THREAD_OUTPUT", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "When `true`, the `COPY` command generates one file per thread, rather than one file in total."},
    {"name": "FILE_SIZE_BYTES", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "If this parameter is set, the `COPY` process creates a directory which will contain the exported files. If a file exceeds the set limit (specified as bytes such as `1000` or in human-readable format such as `1k`), the process creates a new file in the directory."},
    {"name": "PARTITION_BY", "input_type": "VARCHAR[]", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "The columns to partition by using a Hive partitioning scheme"},
    {"name": "PRESERVE_ORDER", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "Whether or not to preserve order during the copy operation. Defaults to the value of the `preserve_insertion_order` configuration option."},
    {"name": "RETURN_FILES", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "Whether or not to include the created filepath(s) (as a `files VARCHAR[]` column) in the query result."},
    {"name": "RETURN_STATS", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "Whether or not to return the files and their column statistics that were written as part of the `COPY` statement."},
    {"name": "WRITE_PARTITION_COLUMNS", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "Whether or not to write partition columns into files. Only has an effect when used with `PARTITION_BY`."}
  ]
}
